data.body: Cluster investigation (ADVANCED, code-tracer lens) ROOT_CAUSE — Track A: test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh never received the cb4a9a7335 RANDOM-suffix isolation. Defect site: line 60 (BRANCH='test-version-bump-$$' — PID only, no ${RANDOM}); inter-test pollution because T1/T2/T3/T5/T6 omit `rm -f` of the shared state file (only T4 line 304 and T7 line 424 clean); T7 line 386 prepopulation writes IN-PLACE (with open(f,'w')) instead of .tmp+mv → mid-write reads see truncated JSON → PARSE_ERROR; _state_is_fresh's 4-hour TTL (merge-helpers.sh:125) prevents _state_init from rewriting a polluted skeleton. Recommended fix: apply cb4a9a7335 pattern (_TEST_BRANCH_TAG=$$-${RANDOM}) + rm -f at end of every test + convert T7's writer to atomic .tmp+mv. Confidence: high. Closes 42bd-5b9b under same root cause.
